Study: Cīrulis et al. (2026). Sex-limited experimental evolution, mating, and sexual conflict in a hermaphrodite. Zoo J Linnean Soc, 206, zlag036.
Interpretation: The positive effect size indicates a different shape in the stylet (mating organ) of worms carrying the female-limited genomic region compared to controls. There was no a priori expectation of how shape would change, but since some change is predicted following removal of the male sex function we have coded this result as positive.
